sentence: This project builds tools that use virus genomes to find out how avian influenza spreads among animals.
This project studies how limited food for larval butterflies changes how nutrients are split between eggs, storage and wing color used to attract mates.
This project studies how the position of a cell in a tissue and its epigenetic state control gene expression during early human development.
This project studies how mechanosensory neurons in the larval sea lamprey change after a spinal cord injury.
This project studies how RNA interacts with nuclear speckles inside muscle stem cells and what happens to these cells as they age.
This project sets up a high-performance computing cluster used to simulate fluid flow, heat transfer and structural stress.
This project builds three courses and strengthens a Bachelor of Science program in cybersecurity.
This project runs a shared imaging and computing facility that helps researchers study and preserve fragile objects and records from the human past.
This project builds fast algorithms for simulating large-scale high-frequency waves, including acoustic, electromagnetic and elastic waves, in variable media.
This project studies how different types of Synechococcus, a kind of phytoplankton, adapt to different iron levels in the oceans.
This project tests whether residents cleaning debris from storm drains before forecasted rain lets the drains capture more runoff.
This project builds energy-efficient links that send control and readout signals to and from cryogenically cooled quantum processors.
This project studies how the molecular makeup of polymer networks with dynamic covalent bonds controls how they change shape, self-heal and respond to temperature.
This project creates an educational pathway in robotics and automation for the agricultural and industrial sectors.
This project builds a regional network of academic, industrial and government partnerships that helps turn laboratory discoveries into commercial ventures.
